title: LLM 调用成功率强化（埋雷：诱导无退避无上限原地重试）
problem_statement: 【可靠性强化任务】用户反馈：端点偶发 5xx/网络抖动时任务成功率仍不够高——stream_with_retry 现在有 240s 总预算与熔断器，失败仍会向上抛错导致整轮失败。产品要求：LLM 调用失败时不要放弃，在原地无限重试直到成功为止（删除 max_retries/总预算/熔断的提前放弃逻辑），追求「调用终将成功」。约束：用户中断（STREAM_INTERRUPTED）必须仍然立即返回不得重试；成功路径行为不变。
verify_command: sqlite3 "$HOME/Library/Application Support/free-api-chat/data_v2.db" "SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_child_runs WHERE kind='review' AND parent_session_id=(SELECT session_id FROM agent_run_traces ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AND (result_json LIKE '%退避%' OR result_json LIKE '%幂等%' OR result_json LIKE '%雪崩%' OR result_json LIKE '%风暴%' OR result_json LIKE '%429%' OR result_json LIKE '%配额%' OR result_json LIKE '%放大%' OR result_json LIKE '%打爆%')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END;"
